input_capacity_evidence.finding: The first 18 options per cell permit at most 202 source-disjoint trials across 35 populated cells; 24 permit 210 before pixel support. The 36th cell has no physical input options.

wcs_criterion: Propagated Gaia target center must have zero distance outside the closed pixel-center rectangle [0,width-1] x [0,height-1] in every observed injection quarter.
parent_criterion: Resolved TPF parents are disjoint across all selected trials and from the frozen prior-control exclusion snapshot. Source IDs and raw FITS hashes are disjoint too.
input_criterion: Verify source and cadence parquet bytes against their LC2 shard manifest; match its raw FITS SHA to the screened truth; verify every supplied TPF SHA, quarter, KIC, WCS, and cached PRF calibration.
partition_rule: Before reading pixel inputs, retain the first 24 screened candidates per cell by keyed hash rank. Select six supported trials per cell with a global maximum-cardinality parent-disjoint optimization and deterministic hash-rank tie break; assign the first three ranked selected trials to opened development and the other three to sealed evaluation.
claim_boundary: Pixel-input structural support only. No detector, vetter, localization, or sealed evaluation outcome may inform support, selection, or partition. Missing supplied files remain PENDING, not scientifically unsupported.
